sentence_stem: Although I was very busy this week,
correct_completion: I still found time to answer your message.
full_sentence: Although I was very busy this week, I still found time to answer your message.
acceptable_variants: I still replied to your email.
I managed to write back today.

options.text: so I stayed at home all day.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not a contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that shows contrast with the first part.

options.text: I still found time to answer your message.

options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about the week, but it does not show the contrast that 'although' requires.
This gives a reason for not replying, which does not contrast with being busy.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a result that contrasts with the first clause. Learners often add 'but' after 'although', which creates a double contrast and should be avoided.
translation: Embora eu tenha estado muito ocupado esta semana, ainda arranjei tempo para responder à sua mensagem.
